verdict.rationale: Bulk operations clearly apply to an observability platform, but the evidence never documents selecting many items, such as alerts, dashboards, or saved views, and acting on them together. The closest items do not qualify. Cloning a dashboard section with its panels is an adjacent grouping feature. Dashboards-as-code, JSON editing, service-account API access and MCP natural-language management are building blocks. The Datadog dashboard migration tool belongs to a migration story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
